newsitem.title: UK: Henlys shares spike on 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Henlys shares spike on 1996 results.

text.p: Shares in Henlys Plc moved sharply higher on Friday after the company announced a 32 percent increase in 1996 pre-tax profits, traders said.
Henlys shares were 25p firmer at 551-1/2p by 0900 GMT.

The vehicle distribution company recorded a 33.3 million sterling pre-tax profit for the period, on turnover of 522.7 million stg, compared with a 25.3 million stg profit on a turnover of 451.6 million stg during 1995.
Henlys' results coincided with the news that the firm's chairman Michael Doherty was to stand down in April, but analysts said the news was unlikely to impact on the stock's price.
"The shares are running away on the results," one analyst said. "I don't think that Doherty's standing down will affect the share price too much."
